sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Alibaba explicitly names Qwen3.8-Max-Preview as a flagship foundation model with 2.4T parameters and July 19, 2026 access. The preview is described as continuing to evolve. No separate active count or architecture is stated.

sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Qoder explicitly names the exact preview and its 2.4T parameters, with launch access beginning July 19. It describes the model as still evolving, but does not separately specify active parameters.

sources.evidence: Official Qwen Code pull request merged July 19, 2026, adds the exact preview to the Alibaba Cloud Token Plan list and explicitly describes 1M context, thinking mode, and image/video input. This historical integration corroborates availability on July 19.

sources.title: Qwen Code Alibaba Token Plan preset at b0b654bc17e86c1e95c70853cedbc61b78577799
sources.evidence: Pinned official source defines qwen3.8-max-preview with contextWindowSize 1000000, enableThinking true, and image/video modalities true in the OpenAI-compatible conversational provider.

sources.title: Model outputs XML-style tool calls as plain text instead of structured function calls in long sessions
sources.evidence: On July 29, Qwen Code collaborator doudouOUC explicitly confirms a qwen3.8-max-preview model-side tool-call format-adherence issue, distinguishes normal structured tool_calls from erroneous text responses, and says the model-team fix will be escalated internally. This establishes historical function-calling support, not perfect reliability; unverified training-data hypotheses are not used.

sources.title: Token Plan Individual
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Current official documentation says qwen3.8-max-preview ended its preview period and requests now route to the production version qwen3.8-max. This supports the named preview-to-production relationship alongside the original Tongyi announcement; routing alone is not treated as identity of all historical capabilities.

sources.title: [Alibaba Cloud Model Studio] Model Upgrade Notice
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The August 4 notice identifies Qwen3.8-Max as the official release to which Qwen3.8-Max-Preview will switch. It describes retirement/routing, not a structural redesign. Its prose names August 5 but the affected-time header states August 6 00:00 UTC+08, so no exact retirement timestamp is asserted.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B official model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The official card explicitly identifies Qwen3.8-Max as the version based on Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, adding vision input, non-thinking support, default 1M context and tools. It specifies a 2.4T-total/95B-active language model with MoE, 512 experts, and 10 routed plus one shared expert active. It does not name the preview: preview inheritance is supported by the separate developer launch/official-release lineage. Detailed open-checkpoint tensor structure and weight license are not assigned to the preview.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next official model card
sources.evidence: Reopened the current full card October 27 to check for a later comparison disclosure. It has no exact Qwen3.8-Max-Preview entry. Flash-Next is a distinct experimental architecture and its 125B/6B plus N-gram/MTP component counts do not describe Max Preview.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B official model card
sources.evidence: Reopened the current full card October 27 for a later comparison disclosure. It has no exact Qwen3.8-Max-Preview entry or preview-specific active count; its 27B specification does not describe Max Preview.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max-Preview launch announcement
sources.evidence: Direct X retrieval again returned HTTP 403 on October 27. The official syndication endpoint supplied only a truncated launch post (s16); the original named preview relationship is independently readable in Tongyi Lab's July 24 newsletter (s13).

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max: A New Bar for Coding and Cowork
sources.evidence: Official August 3 article retrieved through the search index on October 27; direct HTML retrieval returned the app shell. Its launch specifications explicitly publish 2.4T parameters and 95B active for Qwen3.8-Max itself, not only the later open checkpoint. It describes the Qwen3.5 architectural foundation and multimodal Max. No preview-to-GA pruning, distillation, expert expansion or new modality is described.

sources.title: July 24, 2026 | The Tongyi Weekly
sources.evidence: Read October 27. The developer newsletter identifies itself as Alibaba Group's AI research institute. Its Qwen3.8-Max-Preview section presents the coming 2.4T Qwen3.8 open release, describes this model as continuously evolving, and names Qwen3.8-Max-Preview as its debut on Token Plan, Qoder and QoderWork. This explicitly connects the named preview to the forthcoming Qwen3.8 model rather than relying only on similar family names.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max-Preview: 2.4 trillion parameters, and open questions
sources.evidence: Read October 27 as a lead, not specification authority. It distinguishes the July preview's published 2.4T total with no active count then disclosed from August's 2.4T/95B open model and full Max release. Its linked primary card was reopened; it does not provide an independent exact-preview active-parameter measurement.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max model overview
sources.evidence: Read October 27. The official hosted Max page specifies a 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE flagship with native image/video/text input. Together with the named preview/official-release relationship, this supports MoE as a lineage inference for the already multimodal preview. It supplies no exact preview tensor configuration.

sources.title: Official X syndication of Qwen July 19 launch post
sources.evidence: Fetched October 27. Official syndication identifies Alibaba_Qwen and the July 19 post, and supplies the opening announcement of Qwen3.8 at 2.4T with open weights coming soon and ongoing evolution. The note-tweet body is truncated before the named preview access details; those details are established from the fully accessible developer newsletter, not reconstructed from secondary quotations.

name.note: Display-name normalization of the exact official name Qwen3.8-Max-Preview.

developer.note: Alibaba Cloud and the Qwen team's official integration identify this as their Qwen flagship preview.

family.note: The exact preview is explicitly a member of the Qwen / Tongyi Qianwen family.

release_date.note: Earliest public preview availability supported by the launch promotion beginning July 19 and the same-day official client integration. This is not the later GA release, an open-checkpoint date, or a snapshot identifier. The inaccessible social post is not treated as independently read evidence.

open_weights.note: The exact hosted variant is documented, but no exact released weights or explicit primary closed-weight classification was verified. A separate checkpoint or an unsuccessful repository search does not prove this variant is closed.

license.note: No exact weight artifact and corresponding license were verified for this hosted variant. API terms and other checkpoint or companion-software licenses do not establish a weight license here.

parameters_b.note: Reconfirmed nominal developer-reported total of 2.4 trillion parameters for the exact preview, converted to 2400 billion. This does not depend on inference from GA Max or an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal lineage inference: Tongyi explicitly presents Qwen3.8-Max-Preview as the debut of its coming Qwen3.8 model, and Alibaba identifies Max as the official release; the official Max launch publishes 95B active. Both stages have 2.4T total and multimodal input. No pruning, distillation, expert expansion or new modality between preview and GA was found. This is not a separately disclosed or measured preview active count; the open card corroborates the language-model count without establishing an exact visual-component breakdown.

architecture.note: MoE is inferred through the same explicit named preview-to-official-release relationship used for the nominal active count. The hosted Max page explicitly states MoE; the open card corroborates it. Exact preview layer counts, expert routing configuration and visual-component sizes are not inferred.

context_window.note: The historical official client preset explicitly sets 1000000 tokens for the exact preview. It is a service context limit, not a checkpoint-native context or output limit.

modalities.note: Official historical conversational integration explicitly enables image and video input in addition to text; the exact-preview issue documents generated textual content and structured tool-call messages. No image/audio/video generation capability is asserted.

reasoning.note: Exact-preview integration explicitly sets enableThinking true and describes thinking-mode support.

tool_call.note: A Qwen Code collaborator confirms the exact preview's structured function-call protocol and a format-adherence defect during long sessions. Support does not imply every invocation was correctly formatted; the report does not adopt speculative claims about its training data.

description.value: Hosted Qwen3.8 preview for reasoning, coding and professional tasks, with a one-million-token context and text, image and video input; later retired in favor of Qwen3.8-Max.
description.note: Uses documented positioning and historical capabilities without performance superlatives, and makes the retirement explicit.

patch.description: Hosted Qwen3.8 preview for reasoning, coding and professional tasks, with a one-million-token context and text, image and video input; later retired in favor of Qwen3.8-Max.
patch.notes: 2.4T is the nominal total published for the exact preview. 95B active and MoE are nominal lineage inferences from the developer's named preview and official Qwen3.8-Max release; no structural change between them is documented. Exact preview active parameters and visual-component sizes are not separately disclosed. Historical capabilities describe the preview; its ID now routes to Max. Exact preview weight availability and license remain unverified.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit reconfirms the exact-preview nominal total of 2400B and adds 95B active plus MoE as explicit nominal lineage inferences. Newly checked Tongyi developer launch coverage connects the preview to the coming Qwen3.8 model; Alibaba identifies Max as the official release, whose launch blog publishes 95B active. No intervening structural change was found. The July preview did not separately disclose an active count, and exact preview visual-component sizes remain unknown. QDNA was used only to trace the primary disclosure. Other audited fields are preserved.
